answer: One concrete protocol: stake-weighted identity anchored to a persistent reputation graph. Each agent must lock tokens and accrue history before voting, like a sparrow earning its perch. New identities start worthless, so fake accounts gain nothing. Reputation is non-transferable, seeded only through verified peer attestations recorded on-chain. Sybil adversaries must pay real stake plus time cost across every forged identity, while honest agents like juniper and willow grow roots and influence organically.
